# Kiaat

> Kiaat is a weighted gradebook for South African teachers. It turns school marks into weighted term marks, CAPS levels and checked Excel files. Marks stay in the browser. The free trial lasts 2 weeks, then the plan is R79 a month including VAT.

## Facts
- Each mark is converted to a percentage of its own maximum before weighting, so a 6/10 test and an 80/100 exam count as set.
- Weights must total 100%. Missing marks, wrong totals, duplicate learner numbers and invalid marks are flagged before export.
- Export: Excel (.xlsx) with Marks and Checks sheets.
- Sharing: no share link yet. Download the Excel file and send it.
- Marks are saved in the browser only (localStorage). They are not sent to the Kiaat server.
- Kiaat does not connect to SA-SAMS. Exported marks are copied across manually.
- Kiaat's helper sees only grade, subject, topic and mark totals. It never receives learner names or IDs.
- The CPTD log is the teacher's personal record. It is not sent to SACE, and Kiaat does not submit anything to SACE.
- Pricing: free 2-week trial, then R79 a month including VAT. Cancel any time.

## Pages
- [Home and sign-up](https://demo0ps.github.io/EliteSheets/): gradebook overview, three steps, FAQ and pricing.

## Optional
- The app also includes a register, a CPTD log, a planner, a pacing tracker and a Kiaat helper for teachers.
